data.title: 安洁莉娜 · 一束送到的花
data.description: 花店请她帮忙送一束花。她双手接好，问清楚收花人的地址，出门前又看了看天气。
data.camera: 中景，花束和纸包装同框
data.promptProse: Outside a vibrant florist shop, Angelina holds an abundant bouquet of fresh sunflowers and wildflowers wrapped in crisp butcher paper. Her messenger satchel and delivery receipt clipboard rest securely across her shoulder in the warm morning sunshine.
data.animaCaption: Cradling the sunflower bouquet in both arms, she checks the recipient's address on her clip with a bright, beaming smile.
